# NineS — Repository Rules

## Project Overview

NineS is a multi-vertex evaluation, collection, analysis, and self-iteration system for AI agents. Current version: 3.3.0.

- Python 3.12+ (`requires-python >=3.12`), dependencies managed with **uv**
- src-layout: package code lives in `src/nines/`, tests in `tests/`
- Build backend: hatchling; CLI entry point: `nines`

## Development Commands

All commands run through `uv run` via the Makefile:

- `make test` — run pytest on `tests/`
- `make lint` — `ruff check src/ tests/`
- `make format` — `ruff format src/ tests/`
- `make typecheck` — `mypy src/nines/`
- `make coverage` — pytest with `--cov=nines` (HTML report in `reports/htmlcov`)

## Code Style

- Ruff: `line-length = 100`, `target-version = py312`; enabled rule sets: E, F, W, I, N, UP, B, A, SIM, TCH; double quotes for formatting
- Mypy: `strict = true` — all new code must pass strict type checking
- LarkSpace workspace-level rules for other languages (e.g. C++ brace style) do not apply here; this repository is pure Python

## Testing Requirements

- Every new piece of logic must ship with tests; run `make test` before submitting
- Never skip or stub out verification with TODO placeholders — failing checks must be fixed, not bypassed

## Documentation Protocol

- Documentation (`docs/`, MkDocs Material) must be updated in the same change as the code it describes
- Every new docs page must be registered in the `nav` section of `mkdocs.yml`
- `uv run mkdocs build --strict` must pass before merging

## Skill Artifacts Are Generated — Never Commit Them

`.cursor/skills/`, `.claude/`, `.codex/`, and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` are generated by `nines install --target <runtime>`. They are install-time artifacts, not source: do not commit them, and do not edit them by hand — change the generator (`src/nines/skill/adapters.py` / `manifest.py`) and re-run `nines install`.

## `.local/` Whitelist Convention

`.local/` is private by default. Only three subdirectories are team-shared and tracked in git:

- `.local/memory/specs/`
- `.local/research/`
- `.local/human/input/`

Never force-add (`git add -f`) anything outside this whitelist.
